title: gymnadenia hyperborea
intro: Gymnadenia hyperborea, commonly known as the Arctic Lady's Slipper, is a species of orchid native to the Arctic tundra. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Gymnadenia hyperborea involve its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce stress, and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
